recovery_notes.rationale: Testimony records Lucius Eldridge (allotment 86) as Citizen Potawatomie. The matching BLM patent (accession 715714) carries preferred_name = 'Potawatami' (a distinct IATH-canonical tribe from 'Citizen Potawatomi'). Historian arbitration confirms the same individual; this field overrides the crosswalk-resolved authoritative_tribe at load time so the testimony joins to the correct BLM record. The source-document tribe_reservation 'Citizen Potawatomie' is preserved as-recorded.
